sentences.text: The only known specimen is a nearly complete frontoparietal dome belonging to a subadult individual. This fused skull dome measured 53.2 mm in length and 19 mm in maximum thickness. The parietal bones contributed an exceptionally large 41% of the total dome length.
Based on recent dating of the formation containing the fossils, which is between 95.9 and 89.6 million years old, Amtocephale is considered the oldest known pachycephalosaurid dinosaur.
The genus was named in 2011 by Mahito Watabe, Khishigjaw Tsogtbaatar, and Robert M. Sullivan. The fossil site at Amtgai was excavated in 1993, 1994, 2001, and 2004.
The species is classified within the family Pachycephalosauridae.

The time range for this genus spans from the Cenomanian to the Santonian stages (100.5 to 83.6 million years ago). It is debated whether Amtocephale is the oldest pachycephalosaurid, as this depends on the exact age of the geological formation.
